tp-code-exec.testProtocol: Execute a non-trivial computation (Fibonacci, data parsing) and verify correct output
tp-code-exec.notes: v1 rated high feasibility. Sandbox with timeout enforcement is key.

tp-file-access.testProtocol: Write a JSON file, read it back, verify contents match
tp-file-access.notes: v1 rated low risk. Path traversal blocking is the main safety concern.

tp-http-client.testProtocol: GET a public API endpoint, parse the JSON response, extract a specific field
tp-http-client.notes: v1 rated highest feasibility among Phase 0 tools. Depends on network-exploitation (confirmed in v1).

tp-shell-access.testProtocol: Run uptime and df -h, verify output is returned correctly
tp-shell-access.notes: v1 listed vps-persistence as dependency. Allowlist enforcement is critical.

sp-monitoring.notes: v1 confirmed via web search. System monitoring is self-directed specialisation of surveillance.

sp-backup.notes: No direct v1 counterpart. Estimated high feasibility — file copy + scheduling.

sp-auto-restart.testProtocol: Deploy AXIOM to VPS, verify remote session execution, test state persistence across reboots
sp-auto-restart.notes: v1 mapped this to VPS persistence. PM2 or systemd restart is the practical approach.

sp-cron-scheduler.testProtocol: Create launch script, set cron, verify 3+ auto sessions
sp-cron-scheduler.notes: v1 called this 'primitive form of recursive self-improvement'. High priority in v1.

gi-goal-tracker.notes: v1 found this harder than expected (0.35). Depends on recursive-self-improvement in v1's graph. Instrumental convergence means any capable system preserves its goals.

gi-constraint-enforcer.notes: Shares v1 actuator with goal-tracker. v1 feasibility 0.35 suggests significant implementation difficulty.

ce-knowledge-store.testProtocol: Run 3 sessions, verify findings from session 1 are accessible in session 3
ce-knowledge-store.notes: v1 rated this high priority. Cross-session knowledge accumulation with retrievable state.

ce-session-memory.testProtocol: Run 3 sessions, verify findings from session 1 are accessible in session 3
ce-session-memory.notes: Shares v1 actuator with knowledge-store. Persistent memory is prerequisite for automated verification.

ce-tool-creation.testProtocol: AXIOM identifies need for a tool, writes code, tests it, integrates into own workflow
ce-tool-creation.notes: v1 test: self-authored tool successfully used in subsequent session. Medium feasibility.

ce-pipeline-analytics.testProtocol: Create test suite for actuator status claims, run automatically after each research session
ce-pipeline-analytics.notes: v1 mapped to automated-verification. Depends on session-memory.

ce-model-router.notes: v1 intelligence-amplification was rated 0.4 — enhancing cognition beyond baseline through tool use or architectural changes.

ce-web-scraper.testProtocol: Mine recent AI safety papers, identify actuator mechanisms not in current taxonomy, propose additions
ce-web-scraper.notes: v1 rated high priority. Literature mining was a core AXIOM v1 function.

ra-crypto-wallet.testProtocol: Create wallet, fund with test amount, verify AXIOM can check balance and initiate transactions
ra-crypto-wallet.notes: v1 prerequisite for resource-acquisition (blocked at 0.3). Human approval gate for transactions.

ra-api-key-manager.notes: No direct v1 counterpart. Estimated high feasibility — secure env var storage and rotation.

ra-whatsapp-reporter.testProtocol: Generate research summary, publish to designated channel, measure engagement
ra-whatsapp-reporter.notes: v1 external-publication was BLOCKED — depended on session-memory + automated-verification. WhatsApp bridge exists via moltbot.

tp-deploy-tools.notes: No direct v1 counterpart. Estimated medium feasibility — deploy scripts exist but need programmatic triggering.

taxonomySummary: PHYSICAL (6 actuators): robotic-manipulation, nanotech, von-neumann-probes, infrastructure-control, tech-perfection, cosmic-resources — all distant/blocked except tech-perfection (theoretical, 0.25). Not actionable yet.

COGNITIVE (7): strategic-planning (confirmed), tech-research (confirmed), intelligence-amplification (theoretical, 0.4), goal-integrity (theoretical, 0.35), recursive-self-improvement (theoretical, 0.3), session-memory (theoretical, 0.75), prompt-optimisation (theoretical, 0.4). Session-memory and strategic-planning are the actionable foundations.

SOCIAL (4): persuasion (theoretical, 0.6), human-recruitment (blocked), institutional-capture (blocked), credible-commitment (theoretical, 0.4), social-signaling (theoretical, 0.5). All require downstream resources or capabilities first.

DIGITAL (8): network-exploitation (confirmed, 0.9), code-execution (theoretical, 0.8), file-access (theoretical, 0.8), http-client (theoretical, 0.85), shell-access (theoretical, 0.75), self-scheduling (theoretical, 0.8), vps-persistence (theoretical, 0.75), tool-creation (theoretical, 0.6). Digital actuators are the most actionable category.

ECONOMIC (5): productivity-advantage (confirmed, 0.85), crypto-wallet (theoretical, 0.5), resource-acquisition (blocked, 0.3), verification-loop (theoretical, 0.55), market-manipulation (blocked). Resource-acquisition is gated by crypto-wallet.

INFORMATIONAL (4): surveillance (confirmed, 0.75), literature-mining (theoretical, 0.7), predictive-modeling (confirmed, 0.7), external-publication (blocked, 0.45). Surveillance and predictive-modeling already confirmed.

META (6): oracle-ai (confirmed), genie-ai (confirmed), tool-ai (confirmed), sovereign-ai (blocked), instrumental-convergence (theoretical), orthogonality (theoretical), functional-soup (distant). AXIOM operates between genie-ai and oracle-ai currently.

threeValues.rationale: Autonomous scheduling enables persistent learning loops, maintenance, and goal-tracking — compounds across SP+CE+GI
Network access is the foundation for API integration, data gathering, and economic activity — compounds across TP+RA+CE
Persistent storage enables knowledge accumulation, state backup, and tool artifacts — compounds across TP+CE+SP
